import urllib.request
email = 'a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk'
out = r'C:\Users\md1avn\Documents\GitHub\neuron-channels-worktrees\t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp\tasks\t0078_bedb_mobo_v2_ais_tiered_ahp\assets\paper\10.1523_JNEUROSCI.0808-13.2013\files\trenholm_2013_dsgc-electrical-coupling.pdf'
# Try Europe PMC first
candidates = [
    'https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC6705162?pdf=render',
    'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6705162/pdf',
    'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6705162/pdf/zns14927.pdf',
    'https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6705162/pdf/',
]
for url in candidates:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': f'Mozilla/5.0 paper-downloader/1.0 (mailto:{email})'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            ct = resp.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
            data = resp.read()
        print(f'OK {url} | CT={ct} | size={len(data)} | magic={data[:8]}')
        if data[:4] == b'%PDF':
            with open(out, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(data)
            print('SAVED:', out)
            break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'FAIL {url}: {e}')
